description.fallback: Sarada Uchiha and Sumire are held captive by Daemon, but he suddenly releases his grip on their necks. When Daemon states that he has the ability to kill them before they can even react, as he just demonstrated, Sarada questions why he did not do so. Ada ponders why Sarada and Sumire would be immune to Omnipotence.
